evidence.code_snippet:
const workers = await prisma.$queryRaw`
  SELECT id, "nodeId", address, status, "maxConcurrent", "currentTasks",
         token, "lastHeartbeat", "createdAt", "updatedAt"
  FROM "CodeswarmWorker"
  ORDER BY "lastHeartbeat" DESC
  LIMIT 100
` as any[];
return NextResponse.json({ workers });
evidence.summary: GET /api/codeswarm/nodes returns worker JWT tokens (the `token` field is a JWT worker token)
Worker Fastify server binds to all interfaces (0.0.0.0), accessible from any network segment that can reach the worker
Worker callbacks (postEvent, postResult, postHeartbeat) carry no authentication tokens. Callback URL can be overridden by task payload.
POST /api/v1/vulnerabilities explicitly skips authentication, relies on external firewall
NFS upload uses path.join with user-controlled fileName, archive extraction via adm-zip without path traversal checks
Worker callback URL accepts arbitrary origin from task payload (payload.callbackUrl), enabling SSRF to redirect events/results to attacker-controlled servers
